presentation.question: Can the disciples gather enough living testimony to know which road Christ has taken?
presentation.situation: Christ is absent, but repaired nets, shared water, remembered words, and changed lives still point from place to place.
presentation.stakes: Without patient attention, need and rumor will become indistinguishable.
presentation.outcome: The gathered witnesses agree that Christ has gone ahead; the search opens onto another road rather than ending in an apparition.
presentation.completion_memory: The disciples gathered living traces across the land and found a trustworthy direction, though Christ remained ahead of them.

presentation.question: Will a loud claimant turn the search toward spectacle and fear?
presentation.situation: Every road carries reports, and some speakers have begun to claim more than they witnessed.
presentation.stakes: A frightened crowd may follow certainty performed loudly enough.
presentation.outcome: A false claimant gathers a following, becoming a new trouble within the world rather than proof that Christ is absent.
presentation.completion_memory: Contradictory reports hardened around a false claimant, and the travelers had to distinguish spectacle from witness.
